title: Three Satires from Ancient Kashmir (Narmamala, Kalavilasa, Desopadesa)

publication.edition: English translation (based on the Osmania University Sanskrit edition, 1961)

verification.verification_notes: Edition identity (Haksar trans., Penguin Books India 2011, ISBN 9780143063230; volume containing Narmamala, Kalavilasa, Desopadesa) confirmed via publisher catalog metadata on 2026-09-24; full text not inspected. Used as the English access point for Kshemendra's 11th-century Sanskrit satire of greedy officials, load-bearing for this silo's Indian/regional evidence. No passage quoted.

limitations: Sanskrit kavya ornament, courtly bureaucratic diction, and puns resist translation; claims about Narmamala are limited to structure, scenario, and register as rendered in English.

copyright.notes: Penguin Books India translation of an ancient Sanskrit text; original in public domain, translation copyrighted; techniques described, no passage reproduced.
